channel.title: New books from Madiland AI Books
channel.description: New planners, coloring books, journals, puzzles and novels

item.title: Dog Walker Diary 2027
item.description: Keys, routes, owners, weather, payments. Open it on the first Monday of 2027 and write the walks in as they come.

item.title: Dog Groomer Diary 2027
item.description: A bath starts at 9:15, a full groom runs past lunch and a nail trim fits in at 2:45. Open it and book the first week of 2027.

item.title: Crypto Trading Journal
item.description: The liquidation price next to the stop, before you enter. Open it and log three trades in a market that never closes.

item.title: Jodie and the Mermaids
item.description: One hot Saturday, one box of crayons, and one very fast girl who suddenly has a tail. Open the book, read a page, then pick a crayon and color the picture right here.

item.title: Goodnight, Bodie & Jodie
item.description: One sleepover, one jar of fireflies, and one girl who is not sleepy. Not even a little. Open the book, read a page, then pick a crayon and color the picture right here.

item.title: Stock Trading Journal
item.description: The thesis first, and what would prove it wrong. Open it and manage one swing trade from entry to exit.

item.title: Day Trading Journal
item.description: The plan on the left, the truth on the right. Open it and live one market day, bell to bell.

item.title: Bodie and the Dinosaurs
item.description: One rainy day, one box of crayons, and one very small roar. Open the book, read a page, then pick a crayon and color the picture right here.

item.title: Trading Journal
item.description: Stocks, options, futures, forex and crypto on one kind of card. Open it, fill in a trade, and tap the boxes that tell the truth.

item.title: Bodie & Jodie's Easter Egg Hunt
item.description: One garden, one little bunny, and one very special Sparkle Egg. Open the book, read a page, then pick a crayon and color the picture right here.

item.title: Futures Trading Journal
item.description: The loss floor first, the trades after. Open it and fill in one morning on the micros.

item.title: Bodie & Jodie's Not-So-Spooky Halloween
item.description: Five more sleeps until Halloween, and nothing here is too scary. Open the book, read a page, then pick a crayon and color the picture right here.

item.title: Bodie & Jodie's Merry Christmas
item.description: Snow is falling, and Christmas is just six sleeps away. Open the book, read a page, then pick a crayon and color the picture right here.

item.title: Bodie Meets Jodie
item.description: A shy boy, a bold girl, and a golden puppy with a red ball. Open the book, read a page, then pick a crayon and color the picture right here.

item.title: Season to Kill
item.description: Ten countries, ten sauces, ten suspects, one killer with impeccable taste. Open it, dim the lights and read the first chapter.

item.title: Forex Trading Journal
item.description: One trade, from the plan to the truth. Open it and fill in a EUR/USD card, slip by slip.
